definition: A willingness to take needless risks without thinking about the danger.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
quote: Even Silver, eating away, with Captain Flint upon his shoulder, had not a word of blame for their recklessness.
example_sentence: His recklessness on the ski slope cost him a broken wrist.
